source: Dossier 11 §D10.4 — dispatch country to border customs office, 2 rows.
note: The physical land crossing the goods entered by, keyed on the country they were dispatched from. Best-effort seeding, not a register: only two routes are mapped, and a route that is not here omits the whole block. A wrong customs office is a real-world error, so the operator confirms it on the portal rather than being handed a guess.
